findings.detail: bunx tsc --noEmit exits 0 across the whole project (local + aws providers). bun test = 44 pass / 0 fail / 130 expect() across 5 files (providers, rules, draft, pipeline, server). Tests are real: they assert specific ruleIds/severities/evidence, draft placeholders and markers, pipeline >=3 findings incl. >=1 HIGH alert, and every HTTP endpoint status+shape in-process (no socket opened).

src/rules/rule-definitions.ts implements all 7 rules as REAL guarded domain checks (R-CAMPO-OBLIGATORIO, R-PRESUPUESTO-CDP, R-VALOR-INCONSISTENTE, R-MARCA-CERRADA, R-EXPERIENCIA-RESTRICTIVA, R-FECHAS-COHERENTES, R-MODALIDAD-CUANTIA). None always-pass/always-fail; each early-returns [] when its condition is not met and otherwise emits a Finding with location + quoted evidence + technical message. HIGH-severity (and the plan-designated MEDIUM) findings carry a riskAlert. LocalRuleValidator surfaces rule errors with context (no silent failure).

LocalDraftGenerator produces an editable DraftDocument (FTN/FTP/Carta structured sections + full Markdown content). Missing fields render [[COMPLETAR: <label>]]; fields touched by a finding are flagged with the findingId and a visible warning in Markdown; ACCEPT keeps the flag (noting 'observacion aceptada'), REJECT dismisses it.

Hono app exposes all 5 endpoints (POST /documents/upload, GET /documents/:id, GET /documents/:id/draft, POST /documents/:id/decision, GET /search) plus /health. zod schemas validate every body/query at the boundary (strict objects, REJECT-requires-justification refine, upload requires text|contentBase64) and never throw; a central guard()+toHttp() maps all failures to safe 400/404/500 JSON with no stack/PII leak. No-auth gap is documented, not silent: loud boot warning in src/server/index.ts, /health reports auth:'none', and the SPA shows an amber 'MVP: sin autenticacion' banner.

web/index.html reuses product-final.html's 4-screen layout (cargar -> datos -> borradores -> exportar) with CSP relaxed so connect-src allows http://localhost:8787 / 127.0.0.1. web/app.js drives the full demo against the local API (upload -> render extracted+findings+alerts -> view/download draft -> record decision) with a visible error strip.

samples/estudio_previo_pgn_limpio.txt (internally consistent) and samples/estudio_previo_pgn_inconsistencias.txt (seeded with the sin-IVA vs con-IVA value mismatch backed by the CDP, closed Apple/Mac brands on items 3-5 without 'o equivalente', and the restrictive 500-equipos + plataforma-de-audiencias experience) both present and exercised by the pipeline integration test.

iac/template.yaml was EXTENDED, not rewritten (1691 lines, 81 resources parse clean). Adds DraftRetrieverFunction, SearchHandlerFunction (+ least-privilege SearchHandlerRole), GET /documents/{id}, GET /documents/{id}/draft (DraftResource), GET /search (SearchResource) all Cognito-authorized, the matching AWS::Lambda::Permission entries, and the new methods in ApiGatewayDeployment.DependsOn. The broken EventBridge chain is fixed: TextExtractedRule now matches the emitted detail-type 'ExtractionStarted' (documented inline).

src/providers/aws/index.ts exports buildAwsProviders(config) assembling all 7 interface impls (the module the selector dynamically imports for AIDLC_PROVIDER=aws; local path never loads it). README covers install/build/test, run-the-demo, seeded flow, HTTP API, IaC extension + lint, and KNOWN MVP GAPS with an R1-R12 coverage table.

summary: APPROVED. The AgilIA MVP is runnable today and meets every acceptance criterion. Typecheck clean (tsc exit 0) and 44/44 tests pass across providers, rules, draft, pipeline, and server. The 7 interfaces plus local and thin-aws provider bundles exist; the local RuleValidator runs 7 genuinely guarded business rules (no always-pass) emitting findings with location+evidence+explanation and HIGH risk alerts; the DraftGenerator produces an editable FTN/FTP/Carta draft with [[COMPLETAR]] placeholders and finding markers; the Hono server exposes all 5 endpoints with zod boundary validation, centralized leak-free error handling, and an explicitly documented no-auth gap (boot warning + /health + SPA banner); the web SPA reuses product-final.html's 4 screens and drives the full demo; both samples exist with the seeded defects; and iac/template.yaml was extended (new GET methods + Lambdas + permissions + DependsOn, Textract->Comprehend event chain fixed) without rewriting existing resources. README documents install/build/test/demo and MVP gaps. All findings are informational confirmations; none are blocking.
